name: Analysis Blocklist
author: alghostzx
description: Excludes tracks matching Title, Album, Artist, Filename/Path, or Genre regex patterns from AI analysis, purges already-analyzed matching tracks from the vector database, and unblocks tracks when filters are relaxed.

versions.changelog: Initial release: Title, Album, Artist, Filename/Path, and Genre regex blocklist, Dry Run preview, Apply & Purge with automatic IVF index rebuild, unblock reminder on filter relaxation, and real-time worker analysis interception.
